name: dcerecedo-skills
description: dcerecedo's Claude Code skills. explain-flow: explains the control flow behind the current issue with linked UML diagrams and domain-language prose, in a pane and an offline browser view. decycle: untangles circular imports in a Python codebase one problem at a time, producing simulated, test-first tickets for /implement.

editorUrl.title: Editor link template
editorUrl.description: Link opened for a code reference. Placeholders: {abs} absolute path, {path} repo-relative path, {line} line number.

explainFlowOutputDir.title: explain-flow: Output folder
explainFlowOutputDir.description: Where explanations (.json and .html) are written: relative to the repo root, or absolute. {repo} is the repository folder's name, e.g. /tmp/explain-flow/{repo}.

explainFlowOpenBrowser.title: explain-flow: Open browser view automatically
explainFlowOpenBrowser.description: Open the HTML view in the browser after each explanation is rendered.

browserCommand.title: Browser open command
browserCommand.description: Command that opens a file in the browser; the file path is appended.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Interpreter for the Python/Django resolver (e.g. .venv/bin/python). Only the standard library is needed.
